title: Design a safe retention policy for compacted test-run history (test_run_compacted is never pruned)
outcome: Design a safe retention policy for compacted test-run history (test_run_compacted is never pruned)
acceptance: An inventory names every consumer and reference of test_run_compacted rows (projection, restart-risk, receipt/settlement, lifecycle revalidation, recovery and evaluation evidence), their proof/receipt/recovery obligations, retention pins and whether a pruned row could be reconstructed.

A proposed eligibility rule defines when a compacted row may be removed without weakening any obligation, coordinated with the existing session-retention mechanism without assuming archived-session eligibility implies test-evidence eligibility.

A non-destructive dry run on representative retained history reports the rows and bytes the rule would remove and why the rest stay; no deletion, count cap or behaviour change is made by this item, and its findings are reviewed before any implementation item is filed.
